newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabian treasury bill yields mixed.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabian treasury bill yields mixed.

text.p: Yields were mixed at this week's Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency offering of two billion riyals worth of one, three, six and 12 month treasury bills.
Bankers said the yield on 30-day bills was 5.4175 percent from 5.4850 on last week's 28-day bills. The rate on 98-day paper was 5.5425 percent from 5.5472 percent on 91-day bills.
The 182-day bills yielded 5.6669 from a previous 5.6097. The yield on 364-day treasury bills was 5.9208 percent from 5.8341.
The bills were priced at 99.55057, 98.51363, 97.21484 and 94.35156 respectively.
One-month interbank deposits were at 5-9/16, 7/16. Three months were at 5-11/16, 9/16 and six months were at 5-13/16, 11/16. One-year deposits were at 6-1/16, 5-11/16.
